changes.summary: Presented in the Cabinet of Architecture, “Decorating the Wall” explores the rise of decorative arts in the 19th century, when wallpaper, fabrics and murals transformed interior design and opened up a new field of expression to artists. Spurred by the mechanization of manufacturing processes over the course of the 19th century, decoration invited itself into interiors far and wide. Wallpapers, stencil paintings and furnishing fabrics democratized embellishment of the living environment. Numerous manufactories sprang up, producing an abundance of motifs that kept expedient pace with changing tastes. Promoting a comprehensive approach to decoration, many artists availed themselves of the possibilities offered by these techniques that brought art into the realm of industry.
